name: agentic/shop-the-set
title: Shop The Set
description: Split section: a product photo with numbered hotspot pins on the left, a numbered list of real WooCommerce products (image, name, price via get_price_html) with an "Add all to cart" button on the right. hotspotX/hotspotY are each pin's position as a percentage of the FULL, uncropped source photo, matched by number to the product list — view.js recomputes the on-screen position against the actual object-fit:cover crop at render time, so pins stay correct at every screen size.

heading.default: Level up your routine with the bundle
